docs.title: GA4GH Place-Based Exposure Metadata Schema
docs.text:
A LinkML schema describing how an environmental exposure dataset was linked to cohort participants. One ExposureLinkageRecord describes one exposure variable linked in one cohort.

Status: Draft (version 0.1.0), developed by the GA4GH Human Exposome Data Standards Study Group.

  • Schema documentation
  • Downloads: LinkML YAML · JSON Schema
  • Source repository and examples

docs.title: About
docs.text:
Environmental exposures such as air pollution, diet, physical activity, and social stress can influence the onset of disease. Environmental data is captured in different ways by research groups internationally, making it hard to compare or combine.

The Human Exposome Data Standards Study Group is developing shared, machine-readable ways to describe environmental exposures. This schema covers place-based exposures: how a source exposure product was linked to the locations of cohort participants.

Aims of the group: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21877291

docs.title: GA4GH Environmental Exposure Linkage Metadata
docs.text:
Describes how an environmental exposure dataset was linked to cohort participants. One ExposureLinkageRecord = one exposure variable linked in one cohort. Converted from "Implementation 1 - GA4GH Metadata Schema".

URI: https://w3id.org/ga4gh/exposure-linkage

Name: exposure_linkage

docs.text:
Describes how an environmental exposure dataset was linked to cohort participants. One ExposureLinkageRecord = one exposure variable linked in one cohort. Converted from "Implementation 1 - GA4GH Metadata Schema".

URI: https://w3id.org/ga4gh/exposure-linkage

docs.title: Slot: geocoding_mixed_breakdown
docs.text: For MIXED, e.g. "80% building, 20% postcode".

docs.title: Slot: id

docs.title: Slot: last_updated

docs.text: Chemicals: INCHIKEY (preferred), PUBCHEM, DTXSID, CAS. Physical/environmental: ExO, ENVO, MESH. Leave empty if none exists.
